metrics.reliability: runs completed within 300 s / planned runs
metrics.operational_success: correct runs completed within 300 s / planned runs
metrics.token_usage: mean input and output tokens among completed-within-budget requests
metrics.request_latency: median end-to-end request latency among completed-within-budget requests

important_note: Historical provider harnesses were heterogeneous. The paper analysis applies the common 300-s budget to recorded traces and excludes post-budget recoveries from bounded-runtime metrics. Historical execution configuration is preserved separately and must not be confused with the paper-analysis protocol.
